title: Deep Eutectic Solvent Kamlet-Taft Parameters Extraction
description: Schema for extracting DES composition and Kamlet-Taft parameters (α, β, π*). Always expand chemical abbreviations into full names.

article_title.description: The full title of the scientific research paper.

des_entries.description: An array of DES entries focused on composition and Kamlet-Taft parameters.

items.description: A single DES entry with composition and Kamlet-Taft parameters.

components.description: Ordered list of chemical components. Always expand abbreviations into full chemical names.

name.description: FULL chemical name of the component. MUST expand any abbreviation (e.g. convert 'ChCl' to 'Choline chloride', 'U' to 'Urea', 'EG' to 'Ethylene glycol', 'Gly' to 'Glycerol', 'LA' to 'Lactic acid'). Never output abbreviations in this field.

acronym.description: Abbreviation or acronym exactly as written in the paper (e.g. 'ChCl', 'U', 'EG'). If no abbreviation appears, set to null.

composition.description: Compositional value (usually the molar ratio coefficient, e.g. 1 or 2 in a 1:2 mixture).
